entries.protects: The geo-gated Viator candidate resolver pulls a wide enough pool (>=10 on /go) that real venue-specific products (Mote, Selby, Ca' d'Zan) can actually be found, rather than only generic city-wide tours.

blastRadius.detail: A dead/denylisted product reaching a live Book button sends users to a broken or wrong booking flow on a monetized CTA.
